summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures consolidated and rose today. The most-traded contract, I2701, closed at 716 yuan/mt, up 1.27% from the previoustrading day. Spot prices at Qingdao port rose by 6-10 yuan/mt, with traders actively selling while steel mills adopted a wait-and-see sentiment, resulting in limited overall spot trading volume.
